        <div class="td-content">
           <h1 id="overview">Overview</h1>

<p>To set up and run Meshery on Linux or macOS, you will need to install <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">mesheryctl</code>. <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">mesheryctl</code> is the command-line interface (CLI) for Meshery. It is used to install, manage, and operate one or more Meshery deployments. <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">mesheryctl</code> can be installed via <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">bash</code>, is also available <a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/latest">directly</a>, or through <a href="/v0.8/installation/linux-mac/brew">Homebrew</a> or <a href="/v0.8/installation/windows/scoop">Scoop</a>.</p>

<h1 id="brew">Brew</h1>

<h3 id="prerequisites">Prerequisites</h3>

<p>You need to have <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">Brew</code> installed on your <strong>Linux</strong> or <strong>macOS</strong> system to perform these actions.</p>

<h3 id="install-mesheryctl-using-brew">Install <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">mesheryctl</code> using Brew</h3>

<p>To install <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">mesheryctl</code> using homebrew, execute the following commands.</p>

<pre class="codeblock-pre"><div class="codeblock">
 <div class="clipboardjs">
 $ brew install mesheryctl
 </div></div>
</pre>

<p>You’re ready to run Meshery. To do so, execute the following command.</p>

<pre class="codeblock-pre"><div class="codeblock">
<div class="clipboardjs">
 $ mesheryctl system start

</div></div>
</pre>

<p>If you are running Meshery on Docker, execute the following command.</p>

<pre class="codeblock-pre"><div class="codeblock">
<div class="clipboardjs">
 $ mesheryctl system start -p docker

</div></div>
</pre>

<p>Meshery server supports customizing authentication flow callback URL, which can be configured in the following way</p>

<pre class="codeblock-pre"><div class="codeblock">
<div class="clipboardjs">
 $ MESHERY_SERVER_CALLBACK_URL=https://custom-host mesheryctl system start

</div></div>
</pre>

<p><code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">mesheryctl</code> uses your current Kubernetes context, your KUBECONFIG environment variable (<code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">~/.kube/config</code> by default). Confirm if this Kubernetes cluster you want Meshery to interact with by running the following command: <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">kubectl config get-contexts</code>.</p>

<p>If there are multiple contexts in your kubeconfig file, specify the one you want to use with the <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">use-context</code> subcommand: <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">kubectl config use-context &lt;context-to-use&gt;</code>.</p>

<h3 id="upgrade-mesheryctl-using-brew">Upgrade <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">mesheryctl</code> using Brew</h3>

<p>To upgrade <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">mesheryctl</code>, execute the following command.</p>

<pre class="codeblock-pre"><div class="codeblock">
 <div class="clipboardjs">
 $ brew upgrade mesheryctl
 </div></div>
 </pre>

<details>
<summary>
Example output of a successful upgrade.
</summary>

<pre><code>
➜  ~ brew upgrade mesheryctl
==&gt; Upgrading 1 outdated package:
meshery/tap/mesheryctl 0.3.2 -&gt; 0.3.4
==&gt; Upgrading meshery/tap/mesheryctl
==&gt; Downloading https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/download/v0.3.4/mesheryctl_0.3.4_Darwin_x86_64.zip
==&gt; Downloading from https://github-production-release-asset-2e65be.s3.amazonaws.com/157554479/17522b00-2af0-11ea-8aef-cbfe8
######################################################################## 100.0%
🍺  /usr/local/Cellar/mesheryctl/0.3.4: 5 files, 10.2MB, built in 4 seconds
Removing: /usr/local/Cellar/mesheryctl/0.3.2... (5 files, 10.2MB)
Removing: /Users/lee/Library/Caches/Homebrew/mesheryctl--0.3.2.zip... (3.9MB)
==&gt; Checking for dependents of upgraded formulae...

</code></pre>
<br />
</details>

<h1 id="bash">Bash</h1>

<p>To install or upgrade <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">mesheryctl</code> using <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">bash</code>, execute anyone of the following commands.</p>

<h4 id="option-1-only-install-mesheryctl-binary">Option 1: Only install <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">mesheryctl</code> binary</h4>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
 <div class="codeblock">
 <div class="clipboardjs">
  $ curl -L https://meshery.io/install | DEPLOY_MESHERY=false bash -
 </div></div>
 </pre>
<p><br />
<br /></p>
<h4 id="option-2-install-mesheryctl-binary-and-deploy-meshery-on-docker">Option 2: Install <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">mesheryctl</code> binary and deploy Meshery on Docker</h4>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
 <div class="codeblock">
 <div class="clipboardjs">
  $ curl -L https://meshery.io/install | PLATFORM=docker bash -
 </div></div>
 </pre>
<p><br />
<br /></p>
<h4 id="option-3-install-mesheryctl-binary-and-deploy-meshery-on-kubernetes">Option 3: Install <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">mesheryctl</code> binary and deploy Meshery on Kubernetes</h4>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
 <div class="codeblock">
 <div class="clipboardjs">
  $ curl -L https://meshery.io/install | PLATFORM=kubernetes bash -
 </div></div>
 </pre>
<p><br />
<br /></p>
<h4 id="option-4-install-mesheryctl-binary-and-meshery-adapters">Option 4: Install <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">mesheryctl</code> binary and Meshery adapter(s)</h4>

<p>Install <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">mesheryctl</code> binary and include one or more <a href="/v0.8/concepts/architecture/adapters">adapters</a> to be deployed</p>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
 <div class="codeblock">
 <div class="clipboardjs">
  $ curl -L https://meshery.io/install | ADAPTERS=consul PLATFORM=kubernetes bash -
 </div></div>
 </pre>
<p><br />
<br /></p>
<h3 id="start-meshery">Start Meshery</h3>
<p>You are ready to deploy Meshery <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">mesheryctl</code>. To do so, execute the following command.</p>

<pre class="codeblock-pre"><div class="codeblock">
 <div class="clipboardjs">mesheryctl system start</div></div>
 </pre>

<p>If you are running Meshery on Docker, execute the following command.</p>

<pre class="codeblock-pre"><div class="codeblock">
 <div class="clipboardjs">mesheryctl system start -p docker</div></div>
 </pre>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

        <div class="td-content">
          
          <h1>Install mesheryctl</h1>
           <p>Meshery’s command line client is <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">mesheryctl</code> and is the recommended tool for configuring and deploying one or more Meshery deployments. To install <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">mesheryctl</code> on your system, you may choose from any of the following supported methods.</p>

<p><code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">mesheryctl</code> can be installed via <a href="/v0.8/installation/linux-mac/bash">bash</a>, <a href="/v0.8/installation/linux-mac/brew">Homebrew</a>, <a href="/v0.8/installation/windows/scoop">Scoop</a> or <a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/latest">directly downloaded</a>.</p>

<div class="alert alert-info">
<h4 class="alert-heading">NOTE</h4>
Mesheryctl is configured for Kubernetes by default. To specify a different supported platform, use the `-p` flag.
</div>

<h1 id="install-meshery-cli-with-brew">Install Meshery CLI with Brew</h1>

<h3 id="prerequisites">Prerequisites</h3>

<p>You need to have <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">Brew</code> installed on your <strong>Linux</strong> or <strong>macOS</strong> system to perform these actions.</p>

<h3 id="install-mesheryctl-using-brew">Install <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">mesheryctl</code> using Brew</h3>

<p>To install <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">mesheryctl</code> using homebrew, execute the following commands.</p>

<pre class="codeblock-pre"><div class="codeblock">
 <div class="clipboardjs">
 $ brew install mesheryctl
 </div></div>
</pre>

<p>You’re ready to run Meshery. To do so, execute the following command.</p>

<pre class="codeblock-pre"><div class="codeblock">
<div class="clipboardjs">
 $ mesheryctl system start

</div></div>
</pre>

<p>If you are running Meshery on Docker, execute the following command.</p>

<pre class="codeblock-pre"><div class="codeblock">
<div class="clipboardjs">
 $ mesheryctl system start -p docker

</div></div>
</pre>

<p>Meshery server supports customizing authentication flow callback URL, which can be configured in the following way</p>

<pre class="codeblock-pre"><div class="codeblock">
<div class="clipboardjs">
 $ MESHERY_SERVER_CALLBACK_URL=https://custom-host mesheryctl system start

</div></div>
</pre>

<p><code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">mesheryctl</code> uses your current Kubernetes context, your KUBECONFIG environment variable (<code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">~/.kube/config</code> by default). Confirm if this Kubernetes cluster you want Meshery to interact with by running the following command: <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">kubectl config get-contexts</code>.</p>

<p>If there are multiple contexts in your kubeconfig file, specify the one you want to use with the <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">use-context</code> subcommand: <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">kubectl config use-context &lt;context-to-use&gt;</code>.</p>

<h3 id="upgrade-mesheryctl-using-brew">Upgrade <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">mesheryctl</code> using Brew</h3>

<p>To upgrade <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">mesheryctl</code>, execute the following command.</p>

<pre class="codeblock-pre"><div class="codeblock">
 <div class="clipboardjs">
 $ brew upgrade mesheryctl
 </div></div>
 </pre>

<details>
<summary>
Example output of a successful upgrade.
</summary>

<pre><code>
➜  ~ brew upgrade mesheryctl
==&gt; Upgrading 1 outdated package:
meshery/tap/mesheryctl 0.3.2 -&gt; 0.3.4
==&gt; Upgrading meshery/tap/mesheryctl
==&gt; Downloading https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/download/v0.3.4/mesheryctl_0.3.4_Darwin_x86_64.zip
==&gt; Downloading from https://github-production-release-asset-2e65be.s3.amazonaws.com/157554479/17522b00-2af0-11ea-8aef-cbfe8
######################################################################## 100.0%
🍺  /usr/local/Cellar/mesheryctl/0.3.4: 5 files, 10.2MB, built in 4 seconds
Removing: /usr/local/Cellar/mesheryctl/0.3.2... (5 files, 10.2MB)
Removing: /Users/lee/Library/Caches/Homebrew/mesheryctl--0.3.2.zip... (3.9MB)
==&gt; Checking for dependents of upgraded formulae...
==&gt; No dependents found!
</code></pre>
<br />
</details>

<h1 id="install-meshery-cli-with-bash">Install Meshery CLI with Bash</h1>

<p>To install or upgrade <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">mesheryctl</code> using <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">bash</code>, execute anyone of the following commands.</p>

<h4 id="option-1-only-install-mesheryctl-binary">Option 1: Only install <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">mesheryctl</code> binary</h4>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
 <div class="codeblock">
 <div class="clipboardjs">
  $ curl -L https://meshery.io/install | DEPLOY_MESHERY=false bash -
 </div></div>
 </pre>
<p><br />
<br /></p>
<h4 id="option-2-install-mesheryctl-binary-and-deploy-meshery-on-docker">Option 2: Install <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">mesheryctl</code> binary and deploy Meshery on Docker</h4>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
 <div class="codeblock">
 <div class="clipboardjs">
  $ curl -L https://meshery.io/install | PLATFORM=docker bash -
 </div></div>
 </pre>
<p><br />
<br /></p>
<h4 id="option-3-install-mesheryctl-binary-and-deploy-meshery-on-kubernetes">Option 3: Install <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">mesheryctl</code> binary and deploy Meshery on Kubernetes</h4>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
 <div class="codeblock">
 <div class="clipboardjs">
  $ curl -L https://meshery.io/install | PLATFORM=kubernetes bash -
 </div></div>
 </pre>
<p><br />
<br /></p>
<h4 id="option-4-install-mesheryctl-binary-and-meshery-adapters">Option 4: Install <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">mesheryctl</code> binary and Meshery adapter(s)</h4>

<p>Install <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">mesheryctl</code> binary and include one or more <a href="/v0.8/concepts/architecture/adapters">adapters</a> to be deployed</p>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
 <div class="codeblock">
 <div class="clipboardjs">
  $ curl -L https://meshery.io/install | ADAPTERS=consul PLATFORM=kubernetes bash -
 </div></div>
 </pre>
<p><br />
<br /></p>
<h3 id="start-meshery">Start Meshery</h3>
<p>You are ready to deploy Meshery <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">mesheryctl</code>. To do so, execute the following command.</p>

<pre class="codeblock-pre"><div class="codeblock">
 <div class="clipboardjs">mesheryctl system start</div></div>
 </pre>

<p>If you are running Meshery on Docker, execute the following command.</p>

<pre class="codeblock-pre"><div class="codeblock">
 <div class="clipboardjs">mesheryctl system start -p docker</div></div>
 </pre>

<h1 id="install-meshery-cli-with-scoop">Install Meshery CLI with Scoop</h1>

<h2 id="prerequisites-1">Prerequisites</h2>

<p>You need to have <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">scoop</code> installed on your Windows system to perform these actions.</p>

<h3 id="install-mesheryctl-with-scoop">Install <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">mesheryctl</code> with Scoop</h3>

<p>To install <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">mesheryctl</code> using Scoop, execute the following commands.</p>

<pre class="codeblock-pre"><div class="codeblock">
<div class="clipboardjs">scoop bucket add mesheryctl https://github.com/meshery/scoop-bucket.git
scoop install mesheryctl</div></div>
</pre>

<p>You’re ready to run Meshery. To do so, execute the following command.</p>

<pre class="codeblock-pre"><div class="codeblock">
<div class="clipboardjs">mesheryctl system start</div></div>
</pre>

<p>If you are running Meshery on Docker, execute the following command.</p>

<pre class="codeblock-pre"><div class="codeblock">
<div class="clipboardjs">mesheryctl system start -p docker</div></div>
</pre>

<h3 id="upgrade-mesheryctl-with-scoop">Upgrade <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">mesheryctl</code> with Scoop</h3>

<p>To upgrade <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">mesheryctl</code>, execute the following command.</p>

<pre class="codeblock-pre"><div class="codeblock">
<div class="clipboardjs">scoop update mesheryctl</div></div>
</pre>

<p>Continue deploying Meshery onto one of the <a href="/v0.8/installation">Supported Platforms</a>.</p>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

        <div class="td-content">
          
          <h1>Using Multiple Adapters</h1>
           <h2 id="advanced-configuration">Advanced Configuration</h2>

<p>Meshery is capable of running zero or more adapters. Meshery offers many features without the need for adapters. Adapters are optional components that enhance and extend Meshery’s core functionality.</p>

<h3 id="modifying-the-default-adapter-deployment-configuration">Modifying the default adapter deployment configuration</h3>

<p>The number of adapters, type of adapters, where they are deployed, how they are named and what port they are exposed on are all configurable deployment options. To modify the default configuration, find <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">~/.meshery/meshery.yaml</code> on your system. <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">~/.meshery/meshery.yaml</code> is a Docker Compose file.</p>

<h4 id="configuration-running-fewer-meshery-adapters">Configuration: Running fewer Meshery adapters</h4>

<p>To customize which Meshery Adapters are used in which deployments, customize your contexts in your meshconfig.</p>

<p><em>Recommended:</em>
Configure your meshconfig using <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">mesheryctl system context</code> to customize which Meshery Adapters are used in which deployments.</p>

<p><em>Alternative:</em>
Alternatively, directly modify the <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">~/.meshery/meshery.yaml</code> configuration file, removing the entries for any adapters you want to remove from your deployment.</p>

<h4 id="configuration-running-more-than-one-instance-of-the-same-meshery-adapter">Configuration: Running more than one instance of the same Meshery adapter</h4>

<p>The default configuration of a Meshery deployment includes one instance of each of the Meshery Adapters (that have reached a stable version status). You may choose to run multiple instances of the same type of Meshery Adapter; for example, two instances of the Meshery Adapter for NGINX Service Mesh. To do so, you can use either of Meshery’s clients to modify your Meshery deployment:</p>
<ul>
  <li>Using <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">mesheryctl</code>, modify <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">~/.meshery/meshery.yaml</code> to include multiple copies of the given adapter.</li>
  <li>Using Meshery UI, navigate to the Settings page and enter the host and port of your additional adapter.</li>
</ul>

<h4 id="configuration-choosing-an-adapter-while-installing-mesheryctl">Configuration: Choosing an adapter while installing Mesheryctl</h4>

<p>When installing <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">mesheryctl</code> using the Bash installation script, you can choose which adapters to load.
Do so by passing the <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">ADAPTERS</code> environment variable to the Meshery Bash script.</p>

<p><em>For example:</em>
<code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">curl -L https://meshery.io/install | ADAPTERS=consul PLATFORM=kubernetes bash -</code> installs <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">mesheryctl</code> and starts Meshery Server in your connected Kubernetes cluster, deploying only the Meshery Adapter for Consul and not the rest of Meshery’s adapters.</p>

<h5>Demo of Meshery managing deployments across multiple Kubernetes clusters:</h5>

<iframe class="container" width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/yWPu3vq4vEs?start=5041" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture" allowfullscreen=""></iframe>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

        <div class="td-content">
          
          <h1>Meshery Playground</h1>
           <p><em>Try out Meshery Playground at <a href="https://playground.meshery.io/">https://playground.meshery.io/</a></em></p>

<p>Meshery Playground is a web-based, collaborative environment that lets you explore Meshery as a cloud native manager and all of the infrastructure it manages, including multiple Kubernetes clusters, CNCF projects and applications, services, and operators that run on Kubernetes. Meshery Playground provides a sandboxed environment to experiment with different infrastructure configurations and deployment options. Its multiplayer plugins allow you to collaborate in real time with your teammates on infrastructure design and operation.</p>

<p>With Meshery Playground, you can:</p>

<ul>
  <li>Collaborate with other engineers, share your knowledge, and exchange ideas</li>
  <li>Explore new cloud native tools without the need for complex setup or configuration. Simply open your browser and go.</li>
  <li>Design new cloud native scenarios and easily deploy them in the Playground environment. Keep your designs and deploy them in your own environment when you’re ready.</li>
</ul>

<p>You can interactively explore all kinds of cloud native infrastructure and do so without having to install them on your local machine. You can create virtual services and deploy sample applications and observe their behavior in real-time.</p>

<p>Meshery Playground also has pre-built scenarios that demonstrate how to implement specific use cases such as traffic splitting, circuit breaking, and other cloud native patterns.</p>

<h2 id="meshery-playground-faq">Meshery Playground FAQ</h2>

<h4 id="question-why-do-i-need-to-sign-up-or-register-to-use-meshery-playground">Question: Why do I need to sign up or register to use Meshery Playground?</h4>

<p><strong>Answer:</strong> <em>The Playground is connected to live Kubernetes clusters. While these clusters are refreshed on a daily basis, they do need to be protected from nefarious actors who might use these clusters for cryptomining, for example.</em></p>

<p><em>Sign up to receive a user account with perpetually free, full access to the Playground environment.</em></p>

<p><em>The Meshery Playground is connected to live Kubernetes cluster(s) and allows users full control over those clusters. Requiring users to register a user account keeps the Playground safe and healthy for all to enjoy. Without requiring users to sign in, the Meshery Playground would allow anonymous access for anyone and everyone to potentially perform nefarious acts.</em></p>

<h4 id="question-will-i-lose-my-meshery-designs-in-the-cloud-native-playground">Question: Will I lose my Meshery designs in the Cloud Native Playground?</h4>

<p><strong>Answer:</strong> <em>No, all of the designs that you have created in the Meshery Playground are saved to your user account and will be available to you each time you sign in to your account. Your designs will be available in the Meshery Playground and any of your other Meshery deployments, too.</em></p>

<p><em>In other words, all work done in  Designer is persisted to your user account.</em></p>

<h4 id="question-will-i-lose-my-meshery-deployments-in-the-cloud-native-playground">Question: Will I lose my Meshery deployments in the Cloud Native Playground?</h4>

<p><strong>Answer:</strong> <em>Yes, the Meshery Playground clusters are reset on a daily basis. However, only deployments (not designs) that you may have created will be lost.</em></p>

<p><em>In other words, only  Visualizer is reset. All of your work in Meshery UI and  Designer will remain in your user account.</em></p>

<h4 id="question-is-there-a-demo-user-account-that-everyone-can-use">Question: Is there a demo user account that everyone can use?</h4>

<p><strong>Answer:</strong> <em>It is imperative that each user has their own account to ensure seamless real-time collaboration within the Playground. The use of individual accounts is critical to enable multiple people to access and utilize the powerful collaboration features.</em></p>

<p><em>Creating your own account ensures that any designs you create or save will be stored and accessible across sessions, preventing any loss of work.</em></p>

<p><em>To ensure accountability in the Playground, it’s crucial to promote the use of individual named accounts. This helps prevent bad actors from hiding behind anonymous general-use accounts and maliciously abusing the Playground. Therefore, the use of named accounts is an essential step towards achieving this goal.</em></p>

<h4 id="question-can-i-deploy-meshery-on-premises">Question: Can I deploy Meshery on-premises?</h4>

<p><strong>Answer:</strong> <em>Yes, Meshery can be deployed on-premises with a single command to download, install, and run your own instance of Meshery in your environment. See all supported platforms to deploy your own Meshery instance at <a href="https://docs.meshery.io/installation">https://docs.meshery.io/installation</a>.</em></p>

            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });

          <h1>Quick Start Guide</h1>
           <p><a name="getting-started"></a></p>

<p>Getting Meshery up and running locally on a Docker-enabled system or in Kubernetes is easy. Meshery deploys as a set of Docker containers, which can be deployed to either a Docker host or Kubernetes cluster.</p>

<div class="alert alert-warning">
<h4 class="alert-heading">Quick Start Assumptions</h4>
This quick start guide enables you to download, install, and run Meshery in a single command. See all <a href="/v0.8/installation">supported platforms</a> for more specific (and less presumptuous) instructions.
</div>

<h2 id="1-download-install-and-run-meshery">1. Download, install, and run Meshery</h2>

<p>If you are on a macOS or Linux system, you can download, install, and run both <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">mesheryctl</code> and Meshery Server by executing the following command.</p>

<!-- <pre class="codeblock-pre" style="padding: 0; font-size:0px;">
<div class="codeblock" style="display: block;">
  <div class="clipboardjs" style="visibility:hidden;padding: 0;">
    <span style="visibility:hidden">curl -L https://meshery.io/install | PLATFORM=kubernetes bash -</span>
  </div>
  <div class="window-buttons"></div>
  <div id="termynal0" style="width:fit-content;min-height:content-fit;" data-termynal="">
    <span data-ty="input">curl -L https://meshery.io/install | PLATFORM=kubernetes bash -</span>
  </div>
</div>
</pre>-->
<!-- <script src="/v0.8/assets/js/terminal.js" data-termynal-container="#termynal0"></script> -->

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
  <div class="codeblock">
  <div class="clipboardjs">$ curl -L https://meshery.io/install | PLATFORM=kubernetes bash -</div>
  </div>
</pre>

<div class="alert alert-info">
<h4 class="alert-heading">Meshery CLI</h4>
Meshery's command line interface, <code>mesheryctl</code>, can be installed in <a href="/v0.8/installation/mesheryctl">various ways</a>. In addition to <a href="/v0.8/installation/linux-mac/bash">Bash</a>, you can also use <a href="/v0.8/installation/linux-mac/brew">Brew</a> or <a href="/v0.8/installation/windows/scoop">Scoop</a> to install <code>mesheryctl</code>. Alternatively, <code>mesheryctl</code> is also available via <a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/latest">direct download</a>.
</div>

<h2 id="2-access-meshery">2. Access Meshery</h2>

<p>Your default browser will be opened and directed to Meshery’s web-based user interface typically found at <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">http://localhost:9081</code>.</p>

<div class="alert alert-light">
<h4 class="alert-heading">Accessing Meshery Server with Meshery UI</h4>
Meshery's web-based user interface is embedded in Meshery Server and is available as soon as Meshery starts. The location and port that Meshery UI is exposed varies depending upon your mode of deployment. See <a href="/v0.8/installation/accessing-meshery-ui">accessing Meshery UI</a> for deployment-specific details.
</div>

<div class="alert alert-light">
<h4 class="alert-heading">Accessing Meshery Server with Meshery CLI</h4>
Meshery's command line interface is a client of Meshery Server's REST API (just as Meshery UI is). Choose to use <code>mesheryctl</code> as an alternative client as it suits your needs.
</div>

<h2 id="3-select-a-provider">3. Select a Provider</h2>

<p>Select from the list of <a href="/v0.8/extensibility/providers">Providers</a> in order to log in to Meshery. Authenticate with your chosen Provider.</p>

<p><a href="/v0.8/assets/img/meshery-server-page.png">
  <img class="center" style="width:min(100%,650px)" src="/v0.8/assets/img/meshery-server-page.png" />
</a></p>

<h2 id="4-configure-connections-to-your-kubernetes-clusters">4. Configure Connections to your Kubernetes Clusters</h2>

<p><strong>Out-of-Cluster Deployments</strong>
If you have deployed Meshery out-of-cluster, Meshery Server will automatically attempt to connect to any available Kubernetes clusters found in your kubeconfig (under <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">$HOME/.kube/config</code>) and in kubeconfigs uploaded through Meshery UI. Meshery Server deploys <a href="/v0.8/concepts/architecture/operator">Meshery Operator</a>, <a href="/v0.8/concepts/architecture/meshsync">MeshSync</a>, and Broker into the <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">meshery</code> namespace (by default).</p>

<p><strong>In-Cluster Deployments</strong>
If you have deployed Meshery in-cluster, Meshery Server will automatically connect to the Kubernetes API Server available in the control plane.</p>

<p>Visit <i class="fas fa-cog"></i> Settings:</p>

<p><a href="/v0.8/assets/img/platforms/meshery-settings.png">
  <img class="center" style="width:min(100%,650px);" src="/v0.8/assets/img/platforms/meshery-settings.png" />
</a></p>

<p>If your config has not been autodetected, you can manually upload your kubeconfig file (or any number of kubeconfig files). By default, Meshery will attempt to connect to and deploy Meshery Operator to each reachable context contained in the imported kubeconfig files. See <a href="/v0.8/installation/kubernetes">Managing Kubernetes Clusters</a> for more information.</p>

<h2 id="5-verify-deployment">5. Verify Deployment</h2>

<p>Run connectivity tests and verify the health of your Meshery system. Verify Meshery’s connection to your Kubernetes clusters by clicking on the connection chip. A quick connectivity test will run and inform you of Meshery’s ability to reach and authenticate to your Kubernetes control plane(s). You will be notified of your connection status. You can also verify any other connection between Meshery and either its components (like <a href="/v0.8/concepts/architecture/adapters">Meshery Adapters</a>) or other managed infrastructure by clicking on any of the connection chips. When clicked, a chip will perform an ad hoc connectivity test.</p>

<p><a href="/v0.8/assets/img/platforms/k8s-context-switcher.png" alt="Meshery Kubernetes Context Switcher">
  <img class="center" style="width:min(100%,350px);" src="/v0.8/assets/img/platforms/k8s-context-switcher.png" />
</a></p>

<h2 id="6-design-and-operate-kubernetes-clusters-and-their-workloads">6. Design and operate Kubernetes clusters and their workloads</h2>

<p>You may now proceed to manage any cloud native infrastructure supported by Meshery. See all <a href="/v0.8/extensibility/integrations">integrations</a> for a complete list of supported infrastructure.</p>

<p><a href="/v0.8/assets/img/platforms/meshery-designs.png">
  <img class="center" style="width:min(100%,650px);" src="/v0.8/assets/img/platforms/meshery-designs.png" />
</a></p>

<p>🧑‍🔬 Explore these tutorials to learn how to use Meshery for collaboratively managing infrastructure.</p>

<div class="section">

            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

           <h1 id="upgrade-guide">Upgrade Guide</h1>

<h2 id="upgrading-meshery-server-adapters-and-ui">Upgrading Meshery Server, Adapters, and UI</h2>

<p>Various components of Meshery will need to be upgraded as new releases become available. Meshery is comprised of a number of components including a server, adapters, UI, and CLI. As an application, Meshery is a composition of different functional components.</p>

<p style="text-align:center">
<a href="/v0.8/assets/img/architecture/upgrading-meshery.svg">
    <img src="/v0.8/assets/img/architecture/upgrading-meshery.svg" style="margin: 1rem;" />
</a><br /><i><small>Figure: Meshery components</small></i>
</p>

<p>Some of the components must be upgraded simultaneously, while others may be upgraded independently. The following table depicts components, their versions, and deployment units (deployment groups).</p>

<h3 id="versioning-of-meshery-components">Versioning of Meshery components</h3>

<table class="mesherycomponents">
    <tr>
        <th>Components</th>
        <th>Sub-component</th>
        <th>Considering or Updating</th>
    </tr>
    <tr>
        <td class="childcomponent">Meshery Adapters</td>
        <td>Any and All Adapters</td>
        <td>Docker Deployment: Watchtower updates this component in accordance with the user’s release channel subscription.</td>
    </tr>
    <tr>
        <td rowspan="3" class="childcomponent">Meshery Server</td>
        <td>Meshery UI</td>
        <td rowspan="3">Manages lifecycle of Meshery Operator; Adapters, UI, Load Generators, Database.<br /><br />
Docker Deployment: Watchtower updates this component in accordance with the user’s release channel subscription.</td>
    </tr>
    <tr>
        <td>Load Generators</td>
    </tr>
    <tr>
        <td>Database</td>
    </tr>
    <tr>
        <td rowspan="2" class="childcomponent">Meshery Operator</td>
        <td>MeshSync</td>
        <td>Meshery Operator manages the lifecycle of this component and its sub-components.</td>
    </tr>
    <tr>
        <td>Meshery Broker</td>
        <td>Meshery Operator manages the lifecycle of this event bus component.</td>
    </tr>
    <tr>
        <td class="childcomponent">`mesheryctl`</td>
        <td></td>
        <td><code>mesheryctl</code> manages the lifecycle of Meshery Server. <br /><br />
        <ul> 
            <li><code>system start</code> calls system update by default, which updates the server and existing adapters, but doesn’t update <code>meshery.yaml</code>. Unless the <code>skipUpdate</code> flag is used, operators are also updated here.</li>
            <li><code>system reset</code> retrieves <code>docker-compose.yaml</code> from GitHub (use a Git tag to reset to the right Meshery version).</li>
            <li><code>system restart</code> also updates operators, unless the <code>skipUpdate</code> flag is used.</li>
            <li><code>system update</code> updates operators in case of both Docker and Kubernetes deployments.</li>
            <li><code>system context</code> manages <code>config.yaml</code>, which manages <code>meshery.yaml</code>.</li>
            <li><code>mesheryctl</code> should generally check for the latest release and inform the user.</li>
        </ul>
        </td>
    </tr>
    <tr>
        <td rowspan="2" class="childcomponent"><a style="color:white;" href="/v0.8/extensibility/providers">Remote Providers</a></td>
        <td>Meshery Cloud</td>
        <td>Process Extension: Integrators manage the lifecycle of their Remote Providers. The process is unique per provider.</td>
    </tr>
    <tr>
        <td>Meshery Extensions</td>
        <td>Static Extension: Integrators manage the lifecycle of their Meshery Extensions. The process is unique per provider.</td>
    </tr>
</table>

<p>Sub-components deploy as a unit; however, they do not share the same version number.</p>

<h3 id="meshery-docker-deployments">Meshery Docker Deployments</h3>

<p>In order to pull the latest images for Meshery Server, Adapters, and UI, execute the following command:</p>

<pre class="codeblock-pre"><div class="codeblock">
 <div class="clipboardjs">mesheryctl system update</div></div>
 </pre>

<p>If you wish to update a running Meshery deployment with the images you just pulled, you’ll also have to execute:</p>

<pre class="codeblock-pre"><div class="codeblock">
 <div class="clipboardjs">mesheryctl system restart</div></div>
 </pre>

<h3 id="meshery-kubernetes-deployments">Meshery Kubernetes Deployments</h3>

<p>Use <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">kubectl apply</code> or <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">helm</code> to upgrade the Meshery application manifests in your Kubernetes cluster.</p>

<h2 id="upgrading-meshery-cli">Upgrading Meshery CLI</h2>

<p>The Meshery command-line client, <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">mesheryctl</code>, is available in different package managers. Use the instructions relevant to your environment.</p>

<h3 id="upgrading-mesheryctl-using-homebrew">Upgrading <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">mesheryctl</code> using Homebrew</h3>

<p>To upgrade `mesheryctl`, execute the following command:</p>

<pre class="codeblock-pre"><div class="codeblock">
 <div class="clipboardjs">brew upgrade mesheryctl</div></div>
 </pre>

<h3 id="upgrading-mesheryctl-using-bash">Upgrading <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">mesheryctl</code> using Bash</h3>

<p>Upgrade <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">mesheryctl</code> and run Meshery on Mac or Linux with this script:</p>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
 <div class="codeblock"><div class="clipboardjs">curl -L https://meshery.io/install | DEPLOY_MESHERY=false bash -</div></div>
 </pre>

<h3 id="upgrading-mesheryctl-using-scoop">Upgrading <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">mesheryctl</code> using Scoop</h3>

<p>To upgrade <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">mesheryctl</code>, execute the following command:</p>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
 <div class="codeblock"><div class="clipboardjs">scoop update mesheryctl</div></div>
 </pre>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

        <div class="td-content">
          
          <h1>Install Meshery CLI on Windows</h1>
           <p>On Windows systems, <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">mesheryctl</code> can be installed via Scoop or <a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/latest">downloaded directly</a>.</p>

<h2 id="prerequisites">Prerequisites</h2>

<p>You need to have <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">scoop</code> installed on your Windows system to perform these actions.</p>

<h3 id="install-mesheryctl-with-scoop">Install <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">mesheryctl</code> with Scoop</h3>

<p>To install <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">mesheryctl</code> using Scoop, execute the following commands.</p>

<pre class="codeblock-pre"><div class="codeblock">
<div class="clipboardjs">scoop bucket add mesheryctl https://github.com/meshery/scoop-bucket.git
scoop install mesheryctl</div></div>
</pre>

<p>You’re ready to run Meshery. To do so, execute the following command.</p>

<pre class="codeblock-pre"><div class="codeblock">
<div class="clipboardjs">mesheryctl system start</div></div>
</pre>

<p>If you are running Meshery on Docker, execute the following command.</p>

<pre class="codeblock-pre"><div class="codeblock">
<div class="clipboardjs">mesheryctl system start -p docker</div></div>
</pre>

<h3 id="upgrade-mesheryctl-with-scoop">Upgrade <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">mesheryctl</code> with Scoop</h3>

<p>To upgrade <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">mesheryctl</code>, execute the following command.</p>

<pre class="codeblock-pre"><div class="codeblock">
<div class="clipboardjs">scoop update mesheryctl</div></div>
</pre>

<h2 id="install-mesheryctl-as-a-direct-download">Install <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">mesheryctl</code> as a direct download</h2>

<p>Follow the installation steps to install the <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">mesheryctl</code> CLI. Then, execute:</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock"><div class="clipboardjs">./mesheryctl system start</div></div>
</pre>

<p>If you are installing Meshery on Docker, execute the following command:</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock"><div class="clipboardjs">./mesheryctl system start -p docker</div></div>
</pre>

<p>Optionally, move the <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">mesheryctl</code> binary to a directory in your <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">PATH</code>.</p>

<!-- Meshery server supports customizing authentication flow callback URL, which can be configured in the following way
  <pre class="codeblock-pre">
  <div class="codeblock"><div class="clipboardjs">MESHERY_SERVER_CALLBACK_URL=https://custom-host ./mesheryctl system start</div></div>
  </pre>

Type `yes` when prompted to choose to configure a file. To get started, choose Docker as your platform to deploy Meshery. -->

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

           <h1 id="install-meshery-cli-with-scoop">Install Meshery CLI with Scoop</h1>

<h2 id="prerequisites">Prerequisites</h2>

<p>You need to have <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">scoop</code> installed on your Windows system to perform these actions.</p>

<h3 id="install-mesheryctl-with-scoop">Install <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">mesheryctl</code> with Scoop</h3>

<p>To install <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">mesheryctl</code> using Scoop, execute the following commands.</p>

<pre class="codeblock-pre"><div class="codeblock">
<div class="clipboardjs">scoop bucket add mesheryctl https://github.com/meshery/scoop-bucket.git
scoop install mesheryctl</div></div>
</pre>

<p>You’re ready to run Meshery. To do so, execute the following command.</p>

<pre class="codeblock-pre"><div class="codeblock">
<div class="clipboardjs">mesheryctl system start</div></div>
</pre>

<p>If you are running Meshery on Docker, execute the following command.</p>

<pre class="codeblock-pre"><div class="codeblock">
<div class="clipboardjs">mesheryctl system start -p docker</div></div>
</pre>

<h3 id="upgrade-mesheryctl-with-scoop">Upgrade <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">mesheryctl</code> with Scoop</h3>

<p>To upgrade <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">mesheryctl</code>, execute the following command.</p>

<pre class="codeblock-pre"><div class="codeblock">
<div class="clipboardjs">scoop update mesheryctl</div></div>
</pre>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

layout: page
title: Integrations

language: en
permalink: extensibility/integrations
type: integrations
display-title: "true"

list: exclude
abstract: Integrations with other platforms and services.
---
Meshery provides 220+ built-in integrations which refer to the supported connections and interactions between Meshery and various cloud native platforms, tools, and technologies. Meshery's approach is Kubernetes-native which means you can easily incorporate Meshery into your existing workflow without additional setup or integration effort.

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

# Compatibility Matrix

Meshery Server and Meshery Adapters are tested daily for their compatibility with the infrastructure they manage and the platforms Meshery deploys on (Kubernetes and Docker). Integration test results are automatically posted to the following compatibility matrix.

<p><a name="compatibility-matrix"></a></p>

<h1 id="compatibility-matrix">Compatibility Matrix</h1>

<p>Meshery Server and Meshery Adapters are tested daily for their compatibility with the infrastructure they manage and the platforms Meshery deploys on (Kubernetes and Docker). Integration test results are automatically posted to the following compatibility matrix.</p>

}
.nav-link:hover, .nav-link:focus{
    color:#00B39F!important
}
.nav-link{
    border: 0 !important;
    color: black
}
</style>

      width:fit-content;
      cursor:pointer;
      margin-right: auto;
      margin-left: auto;
    }
    .tooltipss .tooltiptext {
    visibility: hidden;
    width: 120px;
    background-color: #555;
    color: #fff;
    text-align: center;
    border-radius: 6px;
    padding: 5px 0;
    position: absolute;
    z-index: 1;
    bottom: 125%;
    left: 50%;
    margin-left: -60px;
    opacity: 0;
    transition: opacity 0.3s;
    }

  .tooltipss .tooltiptext::after {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    top: 100%;
    left: 50%;
    margin-left: -5px;
    border-width: 5px;
    border-style: solid;
    border-color: #555 transparent transparent transparent;
  }
  .tooltipss:hover .tooltiptext {
    visibility: visible;
    opacity: 1;
}


</style>

<script>
  function showCompatability () {
      let percentContainer = document.querySelectorAll(".compatibility")
      for(let i = 0 ; i<percentContainer.length;i++){
        let percentage = parseFloat(percentContainer[i].innerHTML);
        if (percentage >= 90.00){
          percentContainer[i].innerHTML = `
            <div class = "tooltipss" style="text-align:center">
              <img src = "/assets/img/passing.svg" class = "yellowCheckbox" >
              <span class = "tooltiptext">${percentage}%</span>
            </div>
          `
        }
        else if(percentage >=1 && percentage<=89.99){
          percentContainer[i].innerHTML = `<div class = "tooltipss" style="text-align:center">
              <img src = "/assets/img/YellowCheck.svg" class = "yellowCheckbox" >
              <span class = "tooltiptext">${percentage}%</span>
            </div>`
        }
        else if(percentage < 0){
           percentContainer[i].innerHTML = `<div class = "tooltipss" style="text-align:center">
              <img src = "/assets/img/na-icon.svg" class = "yellowCheckbox" >
              <span class = "tooltiptext">Not Applicable</span>
            </div>`
        }
        else{
           percentContainer[i].innerHTML = `<div class = "tooltipss" style="text-align:center">
              <img src = "/assets/img/failing.svg" class = "yellowCheckbox" >
              <span class = "tooltiptext">${percentage}%</span>
            </div>`
        }
      }
    }
  function clickIcon(serviceMesh){
    location.href = `/installation/compatibility-matrix/${serviceMesh}-past-results`
  }

showCompatability()
</script>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>
