        <div class="td-content">
          
          <h1>Contributing to Meshery Schemas</h1>
           <p>This comprehensive guide covers everything you need to know to contribute to the Meshery Schemas repository. Meshery follows <strong>Schema-Driven Development (SDD)</strong>, where the structure of data is centrally defined using schemas that power consistency, validation, and code generation across the platform.</p>

<hr />

<h2 id="table-of-contents">Table of Contents</h2>

<ol>
  <li><a href="#overview">Overview</a></li>
  <li><a href="#prerequisites">Prerequisites</a></li>
  <li><a href="#quick-start">Quick Start</a></li>
  <li><a href="#schema-directory-structure">Schema Directory Structure</a></li>
  <li><a href="#understanding-apiyml---the-construct-index-file">Understanding <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">api.yml</code> - The Construct Index File</a></li>
  <li><a href="#schema-file-roles">Schema File Roles</a></li>
  <li><a href="#naming-conventions">Naming Conventions</a></li>
  <li><a href="#adding-a-new-schema">Adding a New Schema</a></li>
  <li><a href="#modifying-existing-schemas">Modifying Existing Schemas</a></li>
  <li><a href="#code-generation">Code Generation</a></li>
  <li><a href="#go-helper-files">Go Helper Files</a></li>
  <li><a href="#typescript-integration">TypeScript Integration</a></li>
  <li><a href="#common-schema-patterns">Common Schema Patterns</a></li>
  <li><a href="#template-files">Template Files</a></li>
  <li><a href="#what-not-to-commit">What NOT to Commit</a></li>
  <li><a href="#testing-your-changes">Testing Your Changes</a></li>
  <li><a href="#common-mistakes-to-avoid">Common Mistakes to Avoid</a></li>
  <li><a href="#checklist-for-schema-changes">Checklist for Schema Changes</a></li>
  <li><a href="#getting-help">Getting Help</a></li>
</ol>

<hr />

<h2 id="overview">Overview</h2>

<p>Meshery schemas offer a powerful system designed for:</p>

<ul>
  <li><strong>Model-Driven Management</strong>: Meshery uses explicit models for describing infrastructure and applications.</li>
  <li><strong>Dynamic Discovery</strong>: Process different kinds of relationships and styles for adaptive configurations.</li>
  <li><strong>Lifecycle Management</strong>: Track status and lifecycle of resources via schema properties.</li>
  <li><strong>Extensibility</strong>: Open-ended metadata and modular schema components enable expansion.</li>
  <li><strong>Visual Representation</strong>: Properties for styling edges and nodes create user-friendly visuals.</li>
  <li><strong>Automated Operations</strong>: Support validation, automated configuration, and patching.</li>
</ul>

<p>Meshery uses the <strong>OpenAPI v3</strong> specification with a <strong>modular, versioned, and extensible</strong> schema strategy:</p>

<ul>
  <li>✅ <strong>Versioned schemas</strong> for backward compatibility</li>
  <li>🧩 <strong>Modular constructs</strong> for maintainability and reuse</li>
  <li>🧪 <strong>Schemas are used</strong> for validation, API documentation, and automatic code generation</li>
</ul>

<hr />

<h2 id="prerequisites">Prerequisites</h2>

<p>Before contributing, ensure you have the following installed:</p>

<h3 id="1-go-v1240">1. Go (v1.24.0+)</h3>

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight"><pre class="highlight"><code><span class="c"># Verify installation</span>
go version
</code></pre></div></div>

<h3 id="2-oapi-codegen">2. oapi-codegen</h3>

<p>Essential for generating Go code from OpenAPI specifications:</p>

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight"><pre class="highlight"><code>go <span class="nb">install </span>github.com/oapi-codegen/oapi-codegen/v2/cmd/oapi-codegen@latest
<span class="nb">export </span><span class="nv">PATH</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">"</span><span class="k">${</span><span class="nv">GOPATH</span><span class="k">:-</span><span class="nv">$HOME</span><span class="p">/go</span><span class="k">}</span><span class="s2">/bin:</span><span class="nv">$PATH</span><span class="s2">"</span>
</code></pre></div></div>

<h3 id="3-nodejs--npm">3. Node.js &amp; npm</h3>

<p>Required for TypeScript generation and build process:</p>

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight"><pre class="highlight"><code><span class="c"># Verify installation</span>
node <span class="nt">--version</span>
npm <span class="nt">--version</span>
</code></pre></div></div>

<h3 id="4-make">4. make</h3>

<p>The repository uses Makefiles for automation:</p>

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight"><pre class="highlight"><code><span class="c"># Verify installation</span>
make <span class="nt">--version</span>
</code></pre></div></div>

<hr />

<h2 id="quick-start">Quick Start</h2>

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight"><pre class="highlight"><code><span class="c"># Clone the repository</span>
git clone https://github.com/meshery/schemas.git
<span class="nb">cd </span>schemas

<span class="c"># Install dependencies</span>
make setup
npm <span class="nb">install</span>

<span class="c"># Generate all code (Go, TypeScript, RTK Query)</span>
make build

<span class="c"># Build TypeScript distribution</span>
npm run build
</code></pre></div></div>

<hr />

<h2 id="schema-directory-structure">Schema Directory Structure</h2>

<p>All schemas are located in the <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">schemas/constructs/</code> directory:</p>

<div class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight"><pre class="highlight"><code>schemas/
├── constructs/
│   ├── &lt;schema-version&gt;/               # e.g., v1alpha1, v1beta1
│   │   └── &lt;construct&gt;/                # e.g., model, component, design
│   │       ├── api.yml                 # Index file: refs subschemas + defines API endpoints
│   │       ├── &lt;construct&gt;.yaml        # Subschema: data model definition
│   │       ├── &lt;construct&gt;_core.yml    # Subschema: core/shared types (optional)
│   │       └── templates/              # Manually defined template files
│   │           ├── &lt;construct&gt;_template.json
│   │           └── &lt;construct&gt;_template.yaml
│   │
│   ├── v1alpha1/
│   │   ├── core/
│   │   │   └── api.yml                 # Core schema definitions (timestamps, UUIDs, etc.)
│   │   └── capability/
│   │       └── api.yml
│   │
│   ├── v1alpha3/
│   │   └── relationship/
│   │       ├── api.yml
│   │       ├── relationship_core.yml
│   │       └── templates/
│   │
│   └── v1beta1/
│       ├── model/
│       │   ├── api.yml
│       │   ├── model.yaml
│       │   ├── model_core.yml
│       │   └── templates/
│       ├── component/
│       │   ├── api.yml
│       │   ├── component.yaml
│       │   └── templates/
│       ├── design/
│       ├── environment/
│       ├── workspace/
│       └── ...
│
├── models/                             # Auto-generated Go code (do NOT commit)
│   └── &lt;version&gt;/&lt;package&gt;/&lt;package&gt;.go
│
├── typescript/
│   ├── index.ts                        # Manually maintained - public API surface
│   ├── generated/                      # Auto-generated TypeScript (do NOT commit)
│   │   └── &lt;version&gt;/&lt;package&gt;/
│   │       ├── &lt;Package&gt;.d.ts          # Type definitions
│   │       └── &lt;Package&gt;Schema.ts      # Schema as JS object
│   └── rtk/                            # RTK Query client configurations
│
├── dist/                               # Built distribution (do NOT commit)
│   ├── index.js, index.d.ts
│   ├── cloudApi.js, mesheryApi.js
│   └── constructs/&lt;version&gt;/&lt;package&gt;/&lt;Package&gt;Schema.js
│
└── _openapi_build/                     # Bundled OpenAPI specs (do NOT commit)
    ├── merged_openapi.yml
    ├── cloud_openapi.yml
    └── meshery_openapi.yml
</code></pre></div></div>

<hr />

<h2 id="understanding-apiyml---the-construct-index-file">Understanding <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">api.yml</code> - The Construct Index File</h2>

<p>Each construct directory contains an <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">api.yml</code> file that serves as the <strong>index file</strong> for that construct. This is the entry point for code generation tools.</p>

<h3 id="the-three-roles-of-apiyml">The Three Roles of <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">api.yml</code></h3>

<ol>
  <li><strong>References all subschemas</strong> - Aggregates and references all related schema definitions via <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">$ref</code></li>
  <li><strong>Defines API endpoints</strong> - Contains all REST operations (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE) for the construct</li>
  <li><strong>Acts as the entry point</strong> - Used by code generators (oapi-codegen, openapi-typescript)</li>
</ol>

<h3 id="example-apiyml-structure">Example <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">api.yml</code> Structure</h3>

<div class="language-yaml highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight"><pre class="highlight"><code><span class="na">openapi</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="s">3.0.0</span>
<span class="na">info</span><span class="pi">:</span>
  <span class="na">title</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="s">Model API</span>
  <span class="na">version</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="s">v1beta1</span>

<span class="na">paths</span><span class="pi">:</span>
  <span class="na">/api/models</span><span class="pi">:</span>
    <span class="na">get</span><span class="pi">:</span>
      <span class="na">operationId</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="s">getModels</span>
      <span class="na">summary</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="s">Get all models</span>
      <span class="na">responses</span><span class="pi">:</span>
        <span class="s2">"</span><span class="s">200"</span><span class="err">:</span>
          <span class="na">description</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="s">Success</span>
          <span class="na">content</span><span class="pi">:</span>
            <span class="na">application/json</span><span class="pi">:</span>
              <span class="na">schema</span><span class="pi">:</span>
                <span class="na">type</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="s">array</span>
                <span class="na">items</span><span class="pi">:</span>
                  <span class="na">$ref</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="s2">"</span><span class="s">#/components/schemas/ModelDefinition"</span>
    <span class="na">post</span><span class="pi">:</span>
      <span class="na">operationId</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="s">createModel</span>
      <span class="na">summary</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="s">Create a new model</span>
      <span class="c1"># ...</span>

<span class="na">components</span><span class="pi">:</span>
  <span class="na">schemas</span><span class="pi">:</span>
    <span class="na">ModelDefinition</span><span class="pi">:</span>
      <span class="na">$ref</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="s2">"</span><span class="s">./model.yaml#/ModelDefinition"</span>    <span class="c1"># Reference to subschema</span>
    
    <span class="na">ModelReference</span><span class="pi">:</span>
      <span class="na">$ref</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="s2">"</span><span class="s">./model_core.yml#/ModelReference"</span>  <span class="c1"># Reference to another subschema</span>
</code></pre></div></div>

<hr />

<h2 id="schema-file-roles">Schema File Roles</h2>

<table>
  <thead>
    <tr>
      <th>File</th>
      <th>Purpose</th>
    </tr>
  </thead>
  <tbody>
    <tr>
      <td><code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">api.yml</code></td>
      <td><strong>Index file</strong> - aggregates all subschemas via <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">$ref</code> and defines API endpoints for the construct</td>
    </tr>
    <tr>
      <td><code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">&lt;construct&gt;.yaml</code></td>
      <td><strong>Subschema</strong> - defines the main data model (noun) for the construct</td>
    </tr>
    <tr>
      <td><code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">&lt;other-subschemas&gt;.yml</code></td>
      <td><strong>Subschema</strong> - defines core/shared types used by the main schema</td>
    </tr>
    <tr>
      <td><code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">templates/*.json</code></td>
      <td><strong>Templates</strong> - example instances with default values</td>
    </tr>
  </tbody>
</table>

<hr />

<h2 id="naming-conventions">Naming Conventions</h2>

<h3 id="property-names">Property Names</h3>

<ul>
  <li>Use <strong>camelCase</strong> for property fields: <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">schemaVersion</code>, <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">displayName</code>, <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">componentsCount</code></li>
  <li>Identifier fields use <strong>lowerCamelCase with “Id” suffix</strong>: <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">modelId</code>, <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">registrantId</code>, <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">categoryId</code></li>
  <li>Enums use <strong>lowercase words</strong>: <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">enabled</code>, <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">ignored</code>, <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">duplicate</code></li>
</ul>

<h3 id="openapi-schema-names">OpenAPI Schema Names</h3>

<ul>
  <li><strong>PascalCase nouns</strong> under <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">components/schemas</code>: <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">Model</code>, <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">Component</code>, <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">Design</code></li>
  <li><strong>Files/folders are lowercase</strong>: <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">api.yml</code>, <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">model.yaml</code>, <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">component.yaml</code></li>
  <li>Template files: <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">templates/&lt;construct&gt;_template.json</code></li>
</ul>

<h3 id="endpoints-and-operations">Endpoints and Operations</h3>

<ul>
  <li>Paths under <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">/api</code> with <strong>kebab-case, plural nouns</strong>: <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">/api/workspaces</code>, <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">/api/environments</code></li>
  <li>Path params are <strong>camelCase</strong>: <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">{subscriptionId}</code>, <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">{connectionId}</code></li>
  <li>Non-CRUD actions append a verb segment: <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">.../register</code>, <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">.../export</code>, <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">.../cancel</code></li>
  <li><code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">operationId</code> is <strong>camelCase VerbNoun</strong>: <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">getModels</code>, <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">createDesign</code>, <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">registerMeshmodels</code></li>
</ul>

<h3 id="versioning">Versioning</h3>

<ul>
  <li><code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">schemaVersion</code> uses <strong>group/version</strong>: <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">models.meshery.io/v1beta1</code>, <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">components.meshery.io/v1beta1</code></li>
  <li>Version strings follow <strong>k8s-style</strong>: <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">v1</code>, <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">v1alpha1</code>, <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">v1beta1</code></li>
  <li>Semver fields use <strong>standard SemVer</strong>: <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">1.0.0</code>, <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">2.3.1</code></li>
</ul>

<hr />

<h2 id="adding-a-new-schema">Adding a New Schema</h2>

<h3 id="step-1-create-the-directory-structure">Step 1: Create the Directory Structure</h3>

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight"><pre class="highlight"><code><span class="nb">mkdir</span> <span class="nt">-p</span> schemas/constructs/v1beta1/mypackage/templates
</code></pre></div></div>

<h3 id="step-2-create-the-index-file-apiyml">Step 2: Create the Index File (<code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">api.yml</code>)</h3>

<p>Create <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">schemas/constructs/v1beta1/mypackage/api.yml</code>:</p>

<div class="language-yaml highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight"><pre class="highlight"><code><span class="na">openapi</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="s">3.0.0</span>
<span class="na">info</span><span class="pi">:</span>
  <span class="na">title</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="s">MyPackage API</span>
  <span class="na">version</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="s">v1beta1</span>
  <span class="na">description</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="s">API for managing MyPackage resources</span>

<span class="na">paths</span><span class="pi">:</span>
  <span class="na">/api/mypackages</span><span class="pi">:</span>
    <span class="na">get</span><span class="pi">:</span>
      <span class="na">operationId</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="s">getMyPackages</span>
      <span class="na">summary</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="s">Get all mypackages</span>
      <span class="na">tags</span><span class="pi">:</span>
        <span class="pi">-</span> <span class="s">MyPackage</span>
      <span class="na">responses</span><span class="pi">:</span>
        <span class="s2">"</span><span class="s">200"</span><span class="err">:</span>
          <span class="na">description</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="s">Success</span>
          <span class="na">content</span><span class="pi">:</span>
            <span class="na">application/json</span><span class="pi">:</span>
              <span class="na">schema</span><span class="pi">:</span>
                <span class="na">type</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="s">array</span>
                <span class="na">items</span><span class="pi">:</span>
                  <span class="na">$ref</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="s2">"</span><span class="s">#/components/schemas/MyPackage"</span>
    <span class="na">post</span><span class="pi">:</span>
      <span class="na">operationId</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="s">createMyPackage</span>
      <span class="na">summary</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="s">Create a new mypackage</span>
      <span class="na">tags</span><span class="pi">:</span>
        <span class="pi">-</span> <span class="s">MyPackage</span>
      <span class="na">requestBody</span><span class="pi">:</span>
        <span class="na">required</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="no">true</span>
        <span class="na">content</span><span class="pi">:</span>
          <span class="na">application/json</span><span class="pi">:</span>
            <span class="na">schema</span><span class="pi">:</span>
              <span class="na">$ref</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="s2">"</span><span class="s">#/components/schemas/MyPackage"</span>
      <span class="na">responses</span><span class="pi">:</span>
        <span class="s2">"</span><span class="s">201"</span><span class="err">:</span>
          <span class="na">description</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="s">Created</span>

<span class="na">components</span><span class="pi">:</span>
  <span class="na">schemas</span><span class="pi">:</span>
    <span class="na">MyPackage</span><span class="pi">:</span>
      <span class="na">$ref</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="s2">"</span><span class="s">./mypackage.yaml#/MyPackage"</span>
</code></pre></div></div>

<h3 id="step-3-create-subschema-files-optional">Step 3: Create Subschema Files (Optional)</h3>

<p>Create <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">schemas/constructs/v1beta1/mypackage/mypackage.yaml</code>:</p>

<div class="language-yaml highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight"><pre class="highlight"><code><span class="na">MyPackage</span><span class="pi">:</span>
  <span class="na">type</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="s">object</span>
  <span class="na">required</span><span class="pi">:</span>
    <span class="pi">-</span> <span class="s">id</span>
    <span class="pi">-</span> <span class="s">name</span>
  <span class="na">properties</span><span class="pi">:</span>
    <span class="na">id</span><span class="pi">:</span>
      <span class="na">$ref</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="s">../../v1alpha1/core/api.yml#/components/schemas/uuid</span>
      <span class="na">x-order</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="m">1</span>
    
    <span class="na">name</span><span class="pi">:</span>
      <span class="na">type</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="s">string</span>
      <span class="na">description</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="s">Name of the package</span>
      <span class="na">minLength</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="m">1</span>
      <span class="na">maxLength</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="m">100</span>
      <span class="na">x-order</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="m">2</span>
    
    <span class="na">description</span><span class="pi">:</span>
      <span class="na">type</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="s">string</span>
      <span class="na">description</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="s">Description of the package</span>
      <span class="na">x-order</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="m">3</span>
    
    <span class="na">created_at</span><span class="pi">:</span>
      <span class="na">$ref</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="s">../../v1alpha1/core/api.yml#/components/schemas/created_at</span>
      <span class="na">x-order</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="m">10</span>
    
    <span class="na">updated_at</span><span class="pi">:</span>
      <span class="na">$ref</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="s">../../v1alpha1/core/api.yml#/components/schemas/updated_at</span>
      <span class="na">x-order</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="m">11</span>
</code></pre></div></div>

<h3 id="step-4-create-template-files">Step 4: Create Template Files</h3>

<p>Create <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">schemas/constructs/v1beta1/mypackage/templates/mypackage_template.json</code>:</p>

<div class="language-json highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight"><pre class="highlight"><code><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
  </span><span class="nl">"id"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
  </span><span class="nl">"name"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"Example Package"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
  </span><span class="nl">"description"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"An example package instance"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
  </span><span class="nl">"created_at"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"0001-01-01T00:00:00Z"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
  </span><span class="nl">"updated_at"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"0001-01-01T00:00:00Z"</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span></code></pre></div></div>

<h3 id="step-5-build-and-test">Step 5: Build and Test</h3>

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight"><pre class="highlight"><code><span class="c"># Run the build - your schema will be automatically discovered</span>
make build
npm run build

<span class="c"># Verify Go code was generated</span>
<span class="nb">ls </span>models/v1beta1/mypackage/

<span class="c"># Verify TypeScript was generated</span>
<span class="nb">ls </span>typescript/generated/v1beta1/mypackage/
</code></pre></div></div>

<hr />

<h2 id="modifying-existing-schemas">Modifying Existing Schemas</h2>

<h3 id="adding-a-new-field">Adding a New Field</h3>

<ol>
  <li><strong>Update the schema / yml file</strong> (e.g., <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">model.yaml or api.yml</code>):</li>
</ol>

<div class="language-yaml highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight"><pre class="highlight"><code><span class="na">properties</span><span class="pi">:</span>
  <span class="c1"># ... existing properties</span>
  
  <span class="na">newField</span><span class="pi">:</span>
    <span class="na">type</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="s">string</span>
    <span class="na">description</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="s">Description of the new field</span>
    <span class="na">x-order</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="m">20</span>
    <span class="na">x-oapi-codegen-extra-tags</span><span class="pi">:</span>
      <span class="na">yaml</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="s2">"</span><span class="s">newField"</span>
      <span class="na">json</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="s2">"</span><span class="s">newField"</span>
</code></pre></div></div>

<ol>
  <li><strong>Update template files</strong> with default values:</li>
</ol>

<div class="language-json highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight"><pre class="highlight"><code><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
  </span><span class="nl">"newField"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"default value"</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span></code></pre></div></div>

<ol>
  <li><strong>Run the build</strong>:</li>
</ol>

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight"><pre class="highlight"><code>make build
npm run build
</code></pre></div></div>

<h3 id="adding-a-new-api-endpoint">Adding a New API Endpoint</h3>

<p>Edit the <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">api.yml</code> file to add new paths:</p>

<div class="language-yaml highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight"><pre class="highlight"><code><span class="na">paths</span><span class="pi">:</span>
  <span class="c1"># ... existing paths</span>
  
  <span class="s">/api/models/{id}/export</span><span class="err">:</span>
    <span class="na">post</span><span class="pi">:</span>
      <span class="na">operationId</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="s">exportModel</span>
      <span class="na">summary</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="s">Export a model</span>
      <span class="na">parameters</span><span class="pi">:</span>
        <span class="pi">-</span> <span class="na">$ref</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="s2">"</span><span class="s">../../v1alpha1/core/api.yml#/components/parameters/id"</span>
      <span class="na">responses</span><span class="pi">:</span>
        <span class="s2">"</span><span class="s">200"</span><span class="err">:</span>
          <span class="na">description</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="s">Model exported successfully</span>
</code></pre></div></div>

<hr />

<h2 id="code-generation">Code Generation</h2>

<p>The build system generates code from your schemas automatically.</p>

<h3 id="what-gets-generated">What Gets Generated</h3>

<table>
  <thead>
    <tr>
      <th>Output</th>
      <th>Location</th>
      <th>Description</th>
    </tr>
  </thead>
  <tbody>
    <tr>
      <td><strong>Go structs</strong></td>
      <td><code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">models/&lt;version&gt;/&lt;package&gt;/</code></td>
      <td>Strongly-typed models for backend</td>
    </tr>
    <tr>
      <td><strong>TypeScript types</strong></td>
      <td><code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">typescript/generated/&lt;version&gt;/&lt;package&gt;/&lt;Package&gt;.d.ts</code></td>
      <td>Interface definitions</td>
    </tr>
    <tr>
      <td><strong>TypeScript schemas</strong></td>
      <td><code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">typescript/generated/&lt;version&gt;/&lt;package&gt;/&lt;Package&gt;Schema.ts</code></td>
      <td>OpenAPI schema as const JS object</td>
    </tr>
    <tr>
      <td><strong>RTK Query clients</strong></td>
      <td><code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">typescript/rtk/</code></td>
      <td>Auto-generated API hooks for Redux</td>
    </tr>
    <tr>
      <td><strong>Bundled OpenAPI</strong></td>
      <td><code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">_openapi_build/</code></td>
      <td>Merged API specifications</td>
    </tr>
  </tbody>
</table>

<h3 id="build-commands">Build Commands</h3>

<table>
  <thead>
    <tr>
      <th>Command</th>
      <th>Description</th>
    </tr>
  </thead>
  <tbody>
    <tr>
      <td><code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">make build</code></td>
      <td>Full build: bundles OpenAPI + generates Go/TypeScript</td>
    </tr>
    <tr>
      <td><code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">make bundle-openapi</code></td>
      <td>Bundle and merge OpenAPI specs only</td>
    </tr>
    <tr>
      <td><code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">make generate-golang</code></td>
      <td>Generate Go code (requires bundled specs)</td>
    </tr>
    <tr>
      <td><code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">make generate-ts</code></td>
      <td>Generate TypeScript types and schemas</td>
    </tr>
    <tr>
      <td><code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">npm run build</code></td>
      <td>Build TypeScript distribution with tsup</td>
    </tr>
  </tbody>
</table>

<h3 id="dynamic-schema-discovery">Dynamic Schema Discovery</h3>

<p>Schemas are discovered automatically by scanning <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">schemas/constructs/</code> for directories containing an <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">api.yml</code> file. No manual configuration needed!</p>

<hr />

<h2 id="go-helper-files">Go Helper Files</h2>

<p>While Go structs are auto-generated from schemas, you often need to add <strong>custom methods</strong> to make these structs compatible with databases, implement interfaces, or add utility functions. This is done through manually created <strong>helper files</strong>.</p>

<h3 id="when-to-create-helper-files">When to Create Helper Files</h3>

<p>Create a helper file (<code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">*_helper.go</code> or <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">helpers.go</code>) in the generated package when you need:</p>

<table>
  <thead>
    <tr>
      <th>Use Case</th>
      <th>Description</th>
    </tr>
  </thead>
  <tbody>
    <tr>
      <td><strong>SQL Driver Compatibility</strong></td>
      <td>Implement <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">database/sql/driver.Scanner</code> and <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">driver.Valuer</code> interfaces</td>
    </tr>
    <tr>
      <td><strong>Entity Interface</strong></td>
      <td>Implement the <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">entity.Entity</code> interface for database CRUD operations</td>
    </tr>
    <tr>
      <td><strong>GORM Table Names</strong></td>
      <td>Define custom table names via <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">TableName()</code> method</td>
    </tr>
    <tr>
      <td><strong>Utility Methods</strong></td>
      <td>Add helper functions for serialization, validation, or business logic</td>
    </tr>
    <tr>
      <td><strong>Type Conversions</strong></td>
      <td>Add methods to convert between related types</td>
    </tr>
  </tbody>
</table>

<h3 id="helper-file-location">Helper File Location</h3>

<div class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight"><pre class="highlight"><code>models/
├── core/
│   ├── core.go                    # Auto-generated (do NOT edit)
│   ├── helpers.go                 # Manual: utility functions
│   ├── datatype_map.go            # Manual: Map type with SQL driver methods
│   └── datatype_null_time.go      # Manual: NullTime with SQL driver methods
├── v1beta1/
│   ├── model/
│   │   ├── model.go               # Auto-generated (do NOT edit)
│   │   └── model_helper.go        # Manual: Entity interface, TableName, etc.
│   ├── component/
│   │   ├── component.go           # Auto-generated (do NOT edit)
│   │   └── component_helper.go    # Manual: Entity interface, TableName, etc.
│   └── category/
│       ├── category.go            # Auto-generated (do NOT edit)
│       └── category_helper.go     # Manual: Entity interface, TableName, etc.
</code></pre></div></div>

<h3 id="sql-driver-interface-implementation">SQL Driver Interface Implementation</h3>

<p>To store complex types (structs, maps, slices) in SQL databases, implement <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">Scan</code> and <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">Value</code> methods:</p>

<div class="language-go highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight"><pre class="highlight"><code><span class="c">// helpers.go - This is NOT autogenerated</span>
<span class="k">package</span> <span class="n">mypackage</span>

<span class="k">import</span> <span class="p">(</span>
    <span class="s">"database/sql/driver"</span>
    <span class="s">"encoding/json"</span>
    
    <span class="s">"github.com/meshery/schemas/models/core"</span>
<span class="p">)</span>

<span class="c">// Scan implements sql.Scanner interface for reading from database</span>
<span class="k">func</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="n">m</span> <span class="o">*</span><span class="n">MyComplexType</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="n">Scan</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">value</span> <span class="k">interface</span><span class="p">{})</span> <span class="kt">error</span> <span class="p">{</span>
    <span class="n">mapVal</span> <span class="o">:=</span> <span class="n">core</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">Map</span><span class="p">{}</span>
    <span class="n">err</span> <span class="o">:=</span> <span class="n">mapVal</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">Scan</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">value</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">err</span> <span class="o">!=</span> <span class="no">nil</span> <span class="p">{</span>
        <span class="k">return</span> <span class="n">err</span>
    <span class="p">}</span>
    <span class="k">return</span> <span class="n">core</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">MapToStruct</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">mapVal</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">m</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="p">}</span>

<span class="c">// Value implements driver.Valuer interface for writing to database</span>
<span class="k">func</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="n">m</span> <span class="n">MyComplexType</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="n">Value</span><span class="p">()</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="n">driver</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">Value</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="kt">error</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="p">{</span>
    <span class="n">mapVal</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">err</span> <span class="o">:=</span> <span class="n">core</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">StructToMap</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">m</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">err</span> <span class="o">!=</span> <span class="no">nil</span> <span class="p">{</span>
        <span class="k">return</span> <span class="no">nil</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">err</span>
    <span class="p">}</span>
    <span class="k">return</span> <span class="n">core</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">Map</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">mapVal</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">Value</span><span class="p">()</span>
<span class="p">}</span>
</code></pre></div></div>

<h3 id="entity-interface-implementation">Entity Interface Implementation</h3>

<p>For structs that need database CRUD operations, implement the <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">entity.Entity</code> interface:</p>

<div class="language-go highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight"><pre class="highlight"><code><span class="c">// component_helper.go - This is NOT autogenerated</span>
<span class="k">package</span> <span class="n">component</span>

<span class="k">import</span> <span class="p">(</span>
    <span class="s">"fmt"</span>
    <span class="s">"sync"</span>
    
    <span class="s">"github.com/gofrs/uuid"</span>
    <span class="s">"github.com/meshery/meshkit/database"</span>
    <span class="s">"github.com/meshery/meshkit/models/meshmodel/entity"</span>
    <span class="s">"gorm.io/gorm/clause"</span>
<span class="p">)</span>

<span class="c">// TableName returns the database table name for GORM</span>
<span class="k">func</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="n">c</span> <span class="n">ComponentDefinition</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="n">TableName</span><span class="p">()</span> <span class="kt">string</span> <span class="p">{</span>
    <span class="k">return</span> <span class="s">"component_definition_dbs"</span>
<span class="p">}</span>

<span class="c">// Type returns the entity type identifier</span>
<span class="k">func</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="n">c</span> <span class="n">ComponentDefinition</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="n">Type</span><span class="p">()</span> <span class="n">entity</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">EntityType</span> <span class="p">{</span>
    <span class="k">return</span> <span class="n">entity</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">ComponentDefinition</span>
<span class="p">}</span>

<span class="c">// GenerateID generates a new UUID for the entity</span>
<span class="k">func</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="n">c</span> <span class="o">*</span><span class="n">ComponentDefinition</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="n">GenerateID</span><span class="p">()</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="n">uuid</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">UUID</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="kt">error</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="p">{</span>
    <span class="k">return</span> <span class="n">uuid</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">NewV4</span><span class="p">()</span>
<span class="p">}</span>

<span class="c">// GetID returns the entity's ID</span>
<span class="k">func</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="n">c</span> <span class="n">ComponentDefinition</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="n">GetID</span><span class="p">()</span> <span class="n">uuid</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">UUID</span> <span class="p">{</span>
    <span class="k">return</span> <span class="n">c</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">Id</span>
<span class="p">}</span>

<span class="c">// GetEntityDetail returns a human-readable description</span>
<span class="k">func</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="n">c</span> <span class="o">*</span><span class="n">ComponentDefinition</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="n">GetEntityDetail</span><span class="p">()</span> <span class="kt">string</span> <span class="p">{</span>
    <span class="k">return</span> <span class="n">fmt</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">Sprintf</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">"type: %s, name: %s, model: %s"</span><span class="p">,</span> 
        <span class="n">c</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">Type</span><span class="p">(),</span> <span class="n">c</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">DisplayName</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">c</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">Model</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">Name</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="p">}</span>

<span class="c">// Create inserts the entity into the database</span>
<span class="k">func</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="n">c</span> <span class="o">*</span><span class="n">ComponentDefinition</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="n">Create</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">db</span> <span class="o">*</span><span class="n">database</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">Handler</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">hostID</span> <span class="n">uuid</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">UUID</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="n">uuid</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">UUID</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="kt">error</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="p">{</span>
    <span class="n">c</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">Id</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">_</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">c</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">GenerateID</span><span class="p">()</span>
    <span class="n">err</span> <span class="o">:=</span> <span class="n">db</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">Omit</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">clause</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">Associations</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">Create</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n">c</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">Error</span>
    <span class="k">return</span> <span class="n">c</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">Id</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">err</span>
<span class="p">}</span>

<span class="c">// UpdateStatus updates the entity's status in the database</span>
<span class="k">func</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="n">c</span> <span class="o">*</span><span class="n">ComponentDefinition</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="n">UpdateStatus</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">db</span> <span class="o">*</span><span class="n">database</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">Handler</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">status</span> <span class="n">entity</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">EntityStatus</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="kt">error</span> <span class="p">{</span>
    <span class="k">return</span> <span class="no">nil</span>
<span class="p">}</span>
</code></pre></div></div>

<h3 id="deterministic-id-generation">Deterministic ID Generation</h3>

<p>For entities that need consistent IDs based on their content (to prevent duplicates):</p>

<div class="language-go highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight"><pre class="highlight"><code><span class="c">// model_helper.go</span>
<span class="k">package</span> <span class="n">model</span>

<span class="k">import</span> <span class="p">(</span>
    <span class="s">"crypto/md5"</span>
    <span class="s">"encoding/hex"</span>
    <span class="s">"encoding/json"</span>
    
    <span class="s">"github.com/gofrs/uuid"</span>
<span class="p">)</span>

<span class="k">func</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="n">m</span> <span class="o">*</span><span class="n">ModelDefinition</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="n">GenerateID</span><span class="p">()</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="n">uuid</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">UUID</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="kt">error</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="p">{</span>
    <span class="c">// Create identifier from unique fields</span>
    <span class="n">modelIdentifier</span> <span class="o">:=</span> <span class="n">ModelDefinition</span><span class="p">{</span>
        <span class="n">Registrant</span><span class="o">:</span>    <span class="n">m</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">Registrant</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="n">Version</span><span class="o">:</span>       <span class="n">m</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">Version</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="n">SchemaVersion</span><span class="o">:</span> <span class="n">m</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">SchemaVersion</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="n">Name</span><span class="o">:</span>          <span class="n">m</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">Name</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="n">Model</span><span class="o">:</span> <span class="n">Model</span><span class="p">{</span>
            <span class="n">Version</span><span class="o">:</span> <span class="n">m</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">Model</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">Version</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="p">},</span>
    <span class="p">}</span>
    <span class="n">byt</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">err</span> <span class="o">:=</span> <span class="n">json</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">Marshal</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">modelIdentifier</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">err</span> <span class="o">!=</span> <span class="no">nil</span> <span class="p">{</span>
        <span class="k">return</span> <span class="n">uuid</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">UUID</span><span class="p">{},</span> <span class="n">err</span>
    <span class="p">}</span>
    
    <span class="n">hash</span> <span class="o">:=</span> <span class="n">md5</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">Sum</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">byt</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="k">return</span> <span class="n">uuid</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">FromString</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">hex</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">EncodeToString</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">hash</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="p">]))</span>
<span class="p">}</span>
</code></pre></div></div>

<h3 id="type-alias-and-conversion-helpers">Type Alias and Conversion Helpers</h3>

<p>Add type aliases and conversion methods for convenience:</p>

<div class="language-go highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight"><pre class="highlight"><code><span class="c">// model_helper.go</span>
<span class="k">package</span> <span class="n">model</span>

<span class="c">// Type alias for cleaner code</span>
<span class="k">type</span> <span class="n">Styles</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">ComponentDefinition_Styles</span>

<span class="c">// ToReference converts full definition to a lightweight reference</span>
<span class="k">func</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="n">m</span> <span class="n">ModelDefinition</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="n">ToReference</span><span class="p">()</span> <span class="n">ModelReference</span> <span class="p">{</span>
    <span class="k">return</span> <span class="n">ModelReference</span><span class="p">{</span>
        <span class="n">Name</span><span class="o">:</span>        <span class="n">m</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">Name</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="n">Version</span><span class="o">:</span>     <span class="n">m</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">Version</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="n">DisplayName</span><span class="o">:</span> <span class="n">m</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">DisplayName</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="n">Model</span><span class="o">:</span>       <span class="n">m</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">Model</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="n">Registrant</span><span class="o">:</span> <span class="n">RegistrantReference</span><span class="p">{</span>
            <span class="n">Kind</span><span class="o">:</span> <span class="n">m</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">Registrant</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">Kind</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="p">},</span>
    <span class="p">}</span>
<span class="p">}</span>
</code></pre></div></div>

<h3 id="core-utility-types">Core Utility Types</h3>

<p>The <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">models/core/</code> package provides reusable types with built-in SQL compatibility:</p>

<table>
  <thead>
    <tr>
      <th>Type</th>
      <th>Purpose</th>
      <th>Use Case</th>
    </tr>
  </thead>
  <tbody>
    <tr>
      <td><code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">core.Map</code></td>
      <td><code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">map[string]any</code> with SQL support</td>
      <td>Storing JSON objects in database</td>
    </tr>
    <tr>
      <td><code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">core.NullTime</code></td>
      <td>Nullable time with JSON/YAML support</td>
      <td>Optional timestamp fields (e.g., <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">deleted_at</code>)</td>
    </tr>
    <tr>
      <td><code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">core.Time</code></td>
      <td>Time wrapper with custom formatting</td>
      <td>Required timestamp fields</td>
    </tr>
  </tbody>
</table>

<p><strong>Using Core Types:</strong></p>

<div class="language-go highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight"><pre class="highlight"><code><span class="k">package</span> <span class="n">mypackage</span>

<span class="k">import</span> <span class="s">"github.com/meshery/schemas/models/core"</span>

<span class="c">// For nullable timestamps (e.g., deleted_at)</span>
<span class="k">type</span> <span class="n">MyStruct</span> <span class="k">struct</span> <span class="p">{</span>
    <span class="n">DeletedAt</span> <span class="n">core</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">NullTime</span> <span class="s">`json:"deleted_at" gorm:"column:deleted_at"`</span>
<span class="p">}</span>

<span class="c">// For JSON metadata stored as blob</span>
<span class="k">type</span> <span class="n">MyStruct</span> <span class="k">struct</span> <span class="p">{</span>
    <span class="n">Metadata</span> <span class="n">core</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">Map</span> <span class="s">`json:"metadata" gorm:"type:bytes;serializer:json"`</span>
<span class="p">}</span>
</code></pre></div></div>

<h3 id="important-notes-for-helper-files">Important Notes for Helper Files</h3>

<ol>
  <li><strong>File Header Comment</strong>: Always add <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">// This is not autogenerated.</code> at the top</li>
  <li><strong>Same Package</strong>: Helper files must be in the same package as the generated code</li>
  <li><strong>DO Commit Helper Files</strong>: Unlike generated <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">.go</code> files, helper files ARE committed to the repository</li>
  <li><strong>Naming Convention</strong>: Use <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">&lt;package&gt;_helper.go</code> or <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">helpers.go</code></li>
  <li><strong>Pointer vs Value Receivers</strong>: Use pointer receivers for methods that modify the struct</li>
</ol>

<h2 id="typescript-integration">TypeScript Integration</h2>

<h3 id="using-generated-types">Using Generated Types</h3>

<div class="language-typescript highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight"><pre class="highlight"><code><span class="k">import</span> <span class="p">{</span> <span class="nx">v1beta1</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="nx">v1alpha1</span> <span class="p">}</span> <span class="k">from</span> <span class="dl">"</span><span class="s2">@meshery/schemas</span><span class="dl">"</span><span class="p">;</span>

<span class="kd">const</span> <span class="nx">component</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nx">v1beta1</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">Component</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">{</span> <span class="cm">/* ... */</span> <span class="p">};</span>
<span class="kd">const</span> <span class="nx">model</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nx">v1beta1</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">Model</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">{</span> <span class="cm">/* ... */</span> <span class="p">};</span>
<span class="kd">const</span> <span class="nx">design</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nx">v1beta1</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">Design</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">{</span> <span class="cm">/* ... */</span> <span class="p">};</span>
</code></pre></div></div>

<h3 id="using-schema-exports">Using Schema Exports</h3>

<div class="language-typescript highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight"><pre class="highlight"><code><span class="c1">// From main index</span>
<span class="k">import</span> <span class="p">{</span>
  <span class="nx">ModelDefinitionV1Beta1OpenApiSchema</span><span class="p">,</span>
  <span class="nx">ComponentDefinitionV1Beta1OpenApiSchema</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="p">}</span> <span class="k">from</span> <span class="dl">"</span><span class="s2">@meshery/schemas</span><span class="dl">"</span><span class="p">;</span>

<span class="c1">// Direct import</span>
<span class="k">import</span> <span class="nx">ModelSchema</span> <span class="k">from</span> <span class="dl">"</span><span class="s2">@meshery/schemas/dist/constructs/v1beta1/model/ModelSchema</span><span class="dl">"</span><span class="p">;</span>
</code></pre></div></div>

<h3 id="maintaining-typescriptindexts">Maintaining <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">typescript/index.ts</code></h3>

<p>The <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">typescript/index.ts</code> file is <strong>manually maintained</strong> and defines the public API surface. When adding new constructs:</p>

<ol>
  <li>Import components from the generated <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">.d.ts</code> file</li>
  <li>Import the schema from the generated <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">*Schema.ts</code> file</li>
  <li>Add type exports to the appropriate namespace</li>
</ol>

<div class="language-typescript highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight"><pre class="highlight"><code><span class="c1">// Type imports (no .d.ts extension)</span>
<span class="k">import</span> <span class="p">{</span> <span class="nx">components</span> <span class="k">as</span> <span class="nx">MyPackageComponents</span> <span class="p">}</span> <span class="k">from</span> <span class="dl">"</span><span class="s2">./generated/v1beta1/mypackage/MyPackage</span><span class="dl">"</span><span class="p">;</span>

<span class="c1">// Schema imports</span>
<span class="k">import</span> <span class="nx">MyPackageV1Beta1Schema</span> <span class="k">from</span> <span class="dl">"</span><span class="s2">./generated/v1beta1/mypackage/MyPackageSchema</span><span class="dl">"</span><span class="p">;</span>

<span class="c1">// Export in namespace</span>
<span class="k">export</span> <span class="k">namespace</span> <span class="nx">v1beta1</span> <span class="p">{</span>
  <span class="k">export</span> <span class="kd">type</span> <span class="nx">MyPackage</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nx">MyPackageComponents</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="dl">"</span><span class="s2">schemas</span><span class="dl">"</span><span class="p">][</span><span class="dl">"</span><span class="s2">MyPackage</span><span class="dl">"</span><span class="p">];</span>
<span class="p">}</span>

<span class="c1">// Export schema</span>
<span class="k">export</span> <span class="p">{</span> <span class="nx">MyPackageV1Beta1Schema</span> <span class="p">};</span>
</code></pre></div></div>

<hr />

<h2 id="common-schema-patterns">Common Schema Patterns</h2>

<h3 id="core-schema-references">Core Schema References</h3>

<p>Always use the non-deprecated references from <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">v1alpha1/core/api.yml</code>:</p>

<table>
  <thead>
    <tr>
      <th>Type</th>
      <th>Reference</th>
    </tr>
  </thead>
  <tbody>
    <tr>
      <td><strong>UUID</strong></td>
      <td><code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">../../v1alpha1/core/api.yml#/components/schemas/uuid</code></td>
    </tr>
    <tr>
      <td><strong>Timestamp (created)</strong></td>
      <td><code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">../../v1alpha1/core/api.yml#/components/schemas/created_at</code></td>
    </tr>
    <tr>
      <td><strong>Timestamp (updated)</strong></td>
      <td><code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">../../v1alpha1/core/api.yml#/components/schemas/updated_at</code></td>
    </tr>
    <tr>
      <td><strong>Version String</strong></td>
      <td><code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">../../v1alpha1/core/api.yml#/components/schemas/versionString</code></td>
    </tr>
    <tr>
      <td><strong>Semver String</strong></td>
      <td><code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">../../v1alpha1/core/api.yml#/components/schemas/semverString</code></td>
    </tr>
    <tr>
      <td><strong>Input String</strong></td>
      <td><code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">../../v1alpha1/core/api.yml#/components/schemas/inputString</code></td>
    </tr>
  </tbody>
</table>

<h3 id="timestamp-fields-pattern">Timestamp Fields Pattern</h3>

<div class="language-yaml highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight"><pre class="highlight"><code><span class="na">properties</span><span class="pi">:</span>
  <span class="na">createdAt</span><span class="pi">:</span>
    <span class="na">$ref</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="s">../../v1alpha1/core/api.yml#/components/schemas/created_at</span>
    <span class="na">x-order</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="m">14</span>
  
  <span class="na">updatedAt</span><span class="pi">:</span>
    <span class="na">$ref</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="s">../../v1alpha1/core/api.yml#/components/schemas/updated_at</span>
    <span class="na">x-order</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="m">15</span>
</code></pre></div></div>

<h3 id="preserving-field-order-with-x-order">Preserving Field Order with <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">x-order</code></h3>

<p>Use the <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">x-order</code> tag to ensure fields appear in a specific order in generated code:</p>

<div class="language-yaml highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight"><pre class="highlight"><code><span class="na">properties</span><span class="pi">:</span>
  <span class="na">id</span><span class="pi">:</span>
    <span class="na">type</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="s">string</span>
    <span class="na">x-order</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="m">1</span>
  <span class="na">name</span><span class="pi">:</span>
    <span class="na">type</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="s">string</span>
    <span class="na">x-order</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="m">2</span>
  <span class="na">description</span><span class="pi">:</span>
    <span class="na">type</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="s">string</span>
    <span class="na">x-order</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="m">3</span>
</code></pre></div></div>

<h3 id="referencing-other-constructs">Referencing Other Constructs</h3>

<p>When referencing models or other constructs, add <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">x-go-type</code> and <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">x-go-import-path</code> to avoid generating redundant Go structs:</p>

<div class="language-yaml highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight"><pre class="highlight"><code><span class="na">model</span><span class="pi">:</span>
  <span class="na">$ref</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="s">../model/api.yml#/components/schemas/ModelReference</span>
  <span class="na">x-go-type</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="s">model.ModelReference</span>
  <span class="na">x-go-type-import</span><span class="pi">:</span>
    <span class="na">path</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="s">github.com/meshery/schemas/models/v1beta1/model</span>
  <span class="na">description</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="s">Reference to the model</span>
</code></pre></div></div>

<h3 id="annotating-api-paths-for-filtering">Annotating API Paths for Filtering</h3>

<p>Use <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">x-internal</code> to control which bundled output includes the path:</p>

<div class="language-yaml highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight"><pre class="highlight"><code><span class="na">paths</span><span class="pi">:</span>
  <span class="na">/api/entitlement/plans</span><span class="pi">:</span>
    <span class="na">get</span><span class="pi">:</span>
      <span class="na">x-internal</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="pi">[</span><span class="s2">"</span><span class="s">cloud"</span><span class="pi">]</span>  <span class="c1"># Only included in cloud_openapi.yml</span>
      <span class="na">operationId</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="s">getPlans</span>
      <span class="c1"># ...</span>
</code></pre></div></div>

<ul>
  <li><strong>With <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">x-internal</code></strong>: Included only in the specified clients</li>
  <li><strong>Without <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">x-internal</code></strong>: Included in <strong>all</strong> clients</li>
</ul>

<hr />

<h2 id="template-files">Template Files</h2>

<p>Templates are manually defined files in the <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">templates/</code> subdirectory. They provide example instances with default values.</p>

<h3 id="template-structure">Template Structure</h3>

<div class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight"><pre class="highlight"><code>constructs/v1beta1/model/templates/
├── model_template.json         # Default JSON template
├── model_template.yaml         # Default YAML template
├── model_minimal_template.json # Minimal variant (optional)
└── model_full_template.yaml    # Full variant (optional)
</code></pre></div></div>

<h3 id="template-content-example">Template Content Example</h3>

<div class="language-json highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight"><pre class="highlight"><code><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
  </span><span class="nl">"id"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
  </span><span class="nl">"schemaVersion"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"models.meshery.io/v1beta1"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
  </span><span class="nl">"version"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"1.0.0"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
  </span><span class="nl">"name"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"example-model"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
  </span><span class="nl">"displayName"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"Example Model"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
  </span><span class="nl">"description"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"An example model template"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
  </span><span class="nl">"created_at"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"0001-01-01T00:00:00Z"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
  </span><span class="nl">"updated_at"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"0001-01-01T00:00:00Z"</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span></code></pre></div></div>

<h3 id="when-to-update-templates">When to Update Templates</h3>

<ul>
  <li>When adding new required fields to a schema</li>
  <li>When changing default values</li>
  <li>When adding new optional fields that should have example values</li>
</ul>

<hr />

<h2 id="what-not-to-commit">What NOT to Commit</h2>

<p><strong>CRITICAL</strong>: Do not commit generated files. Only commit source schema files.</p>

<h3 id="-do-not-commit">❌ Do NOT Commit</h3>

<table>
  <thead>
    <tr>
      <th>Directory/File</th>
      <th>Description</th>
    </tr>
  </thead>
  <tbody>
    <tr>
      <td><code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">models/&lt;version&gt;/&lt;package&gt;/&lt;package&gt;.go</code></td>
      <td>Auto-generated Go structs</td>
    </tr>
    <tr>
      <td><code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">typescript/generated/</code></td>
      <td>Generated TypeScript types and schemas</td>
    </tr>
    <tr>
      <td><code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">dist/</code></td>
      <td>Built distribution files</td>
    </tr>
    <tr>
      <td><code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">_openapi_build/</code></td>
      <td>Bundled OpenAPI specs</td>
    </tr>
    <tr>
      <td><code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">merged_openapi.yml</code></td>
      <td>Generated merged spec</td>
    </tr>
    <tr>
      <td><code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">cloud_openapi.yml</code></td>
      <td>Generated cloud spec</td>
    </tr>
    <tr>
      <td><code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">meshery_openapi.yml</code></td>
      <td>Generated meshery spec</td>
    </tr>
  </tbody>
</table>

<h3 id="-do-commit">✅ DO Commit</h3>

<table>
  <thead>
    <tr>
      <th>Directory/File</th>
      <th>Description</th>
    </tr>
  </thead>
  <tbody>
    <tr>
      <td><code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">constructs/&lt;version&gt;/&lt;package&gt;/api.yml</code></td>
      <td>Index file for each construct</td>
    </tr>
    <tr>
      <td><code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">constructs/&lt;version&gt;/&lt;package&gt;/*.yaml</code></td>
      <td>Subschema files</td>
    </tr>
    <tr>
      <td><code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">constructs/&lt;version&gt;/&lt;package&gt;/*.json</code></td>
      <td>Schema files in JSON format</td>
    </tr>
    <tr>
      <td><code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">constructs/&lt;version&gt;/&lt;package&gt;/templates/</code></td>
      <td>Template files</td>
    </tr>
    <tr>
      <td><code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">typescript/index.ts</code></td>
      <td>Manually maintained public API</td>
    </tr>
    <tr>
      <td><code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">models/&lt;version&gt;/&lt;package&gt;/*_helper.go</code></td>
      <td><strong>Manual</strong> Go helper files (SQL drivers, Entity interface)</td>
    </tr>
    <tr>
      <td><code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">models/&lt;version&gt;/&lt;package&gt;/helpers.go</code></td>
      <td><strong>Manual</strong> Go utility functions</td>
    </tr>
    <tr>
      <td><code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">models/core/datatype_*.go</code></td>
      <td><strong>Manual</strong> Core data type definitions</td>
    </tr>
  </tbody>
</table>

<blockquote>
  <p><strong>Note</strong>: The <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">models/</code> directory contains both auto-generated files (e.g., <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">model.go</code>) and manually created helper files (e.g., <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">model_helper.go</code>). Only the auto-generated struct files should NOT be committed. Helper files that implement interfaces, SQL drivers, and utility methods ARE committed and maintained manually.</p>
</blockquote>

<hr />

<h2 id="testing-your-changes">Testing Your Changes</h2>

<h3 id="run-full-build">Run Full Build</h3>

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight"><pre class="highlight"><code>make build
npm run build
</code></pre></div></div>

<h3 id="run-go-tests">Run Go Tests</h3>

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight"><pre class="highlight"><code>go <span class="nb">test</span> ./...
</code></pre></div></div>

<h3 id="verify-generated-code">Verify Generated Code</h3>

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight"><pre class="highlight"><code><span class="c"># Check Go code compiles</span>
go build ./...

<span class="c"># Check TypeScript compiles</span>
npm run build
</code></pre></div></div>

<hr />

<h2 id="common-mistakes-to-avoid">Common Mistakes to Avoid</h2>

<ol>
  <li>❌ <strong>Committing auto-generated Go structs</strong> (<code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">models/&lt;pkg&gt;/&lt;pkg&gt;.go</code>) - but DO commit helper files</li>
  <li>❌ <strong>Using deprecated <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">core.json</code></strong> references instead of <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">v1alpha1/core/api.yml</code></li>
  <li>❌ <strong>Adding redundant <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">x-oapi-codegen-extra-tags</code></strong> when using core schema references</li>
  <li>❌ <strong>Forgetting to update template files</strong> when adding new fields</li>
  <li>❌ <strong>Not testing the build</strong> after schema changes</li>
  <li>❌ <strong>Placing template files outside</strong> the <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">templates/</code> subdirectory</li>
  <li>❌ <strong>Using <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">.d.ts</code> extension</strong> in TypeScript import paths</li>
  <li>❌ <strong>Assuming schema property names are PascalCase</strong> (check actual generated files)</li>
  <li>❌ <strong>Not adding new schemas to <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">typescript/index.ts</code></strong> for public API exposure</li>
  <li>❌ <strong>Forgetting <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">x-go-type</code></strong> when referencing other constructs</li>
  <li>❌ <strong>Editing auto-generated <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">.go</code> files</strong> instead of creating helper files</li>
  <li>❌ <strong>Forgetting <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">// This is not autogenerated.</code></strong> comment in helper files</li>
  <li>❌ <strong>Missing <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">TableName()</code> method</strong> in helper files for GORM entities</li>
  <li>❌ <strong>Not implementing <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">Scan()</code>/<code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">Value()</code></strong> for complex types stored in SQL</li>
</ol>

<hr />

<h2 id="checklist-for-schema-changes">Checklist for Schema Changes</h2>

<p>Before submitting a PR, verify:</p>

<ul class="task-list">
  <li class="task-list-item"><input type="checkbox" class="task-list-item-checkbox" disabled="disabled" />Modified only schema YAML/JSON files (not auto-generated code)</li>

<h3 id="1-mesheryctl-contributor-flow">1. Mesheryctl Contributor Flow</h3>

<p>a. Add a new schema on a new command</p>

<p><strong>Example:</strong> You want to add a <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">mesheryctl model build</code> command. 
  <strong>Steps:</strong></p>
<ul>
  <li>Add the new verb in <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">openapi.yaml</code> under the appropriate construct (e.g., <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">model/</code>)</li>
  <li>Update <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">&lt;construct&gt;.json</code> if new properties are needed</li>
  <li>Run:
    <div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight"><pre class="highlight"><code>  make generate-types
  make golang-generate 
</code></pre></div>    </div>
  </li>
  <li>Implement the CLI logic</li>
  <li>Add tests (Check existing unit tests for format)</li>
</ul>

<p>b. Add an existing schema on an existing command</p>

<p><strong>Example</strong>: 
  You detect a part of existing code that is not following the schema driven development principle (model is a struct created in mesheryctl command), you have two options:</p>
<ul>
  <li>If you know how to implement, update the existing code to use a proper struct generated from the <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">meshery/schemas</code> repository
    <ul>
      <li>Update the CLI logic</li>
      <li>Add/Adjust tests if needed</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
  <li>If you don’t know how to implement it, open an issue on Github using either a mesheryctl issue template (<a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/issues/new?template=mesheryctl_feature.md">feature</a>, <a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/issues/new?template=mesheryctl_bug.md">bug</a>)</li>
</ul>

<p>c. Add a new schema on an existing command</p>

<p><strong>Steps:</strong></p>
<ul>
  <li>Add the new verb in <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">openapi.yaml</code> under the appropriate construct (e.g., <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">model/</code>)</li>
  <li>Update <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">&lt;construct&gt;.json</code> if new properties are needed</li>
  <li>Run:
    <div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight"><pre class="highlight"><code>  make generate-types
  make golang-generate 
</code></pre></div>    </div>
  </li>
  <li>Update the CLI logic</li>
  <li>Add/Adjust tests if needed</li>
</ul>

<blockquote>
  <p><em>Why it matters:</em> This reduces drift between backend logic and API contract, enforces consistency between Meshery’s components (Server, UI, CLI) and , resulting in higher quality code.</p>
</blockquote>

<h3 id="2-meshery-server-contributor-flow">2. Meshery Server Contributor Flow</h3>
<p><strong>Example:</strong> Add a new <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">status</code> field to <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">component</code>.
<strong>Steps:</strong></p>
<ul>
  <li>Add the new property in <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">component.json</code></li>
  <li>Run:
    <div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight"><pre class="highlight"><code>make validate-schemas
make golang-generate
</code></pre></div>    </div>
  </li>
  <li>The generated Go structs (from <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">oapi-codegen</code>) are used in the backend.</li>
  <li>If the backend uses GORM with auto-migration enabled, these structs may be used to update the DB schema.</li>
  <li>Avoid manually editing the generated models, as they will be overwritten when schemas are regenerated.</li>
</ul>

<blockquote>
  <p><em>Why it matters:</em> This reduces drift between backend logic and API contract, enforces consistency between Meshery’s components (Server, UI, CLI) and , resulting in higher quality code.</p>
</blockquote>

<h3 id="3-meshery-ui-contributor-flow">3. Meshery UI Contributor Flow</h3>
<p><strong>Example:</strong> Show the new <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">version</code> field on the Model dashboard. 
<strong>Steps:</strong></p>
<ul>
  <li>Check <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">openapi.yaml</code> to verify the new field exists</li>
  <li>Wait for the backend to regenerate and expose the property</li>
  <li>Use RTK + TypeScript types to access and render data</li>
</ul>

<blockquote>
  <p><strong>Note</strong>: <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">make generate-types</code> now generates only TypeScript types and schema-related objects. <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">_template.json</code> / <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">_template.yaml</code> files are no longer auto-generated.</p>
</blockquote>

<p><em>Why it matters:</em> UI stays in sync with the backend - fewer bugs, fewer mismatches, easier onboarding.</p>

<h3 id="4-meshery-docs-contributor-flow">4. Meshery Docs Contributor Flow</h3>
<p><strong>Example:</strong> You are writing a guide!
<strong>Steps:</strong></p>
<ul>
  <li>Read the schema structure and workflows</li>
  <li>Walk through the scenarios above</li>
  <li>Write a guide that’s accurate, actionable, and friendly</li>
</ul>

<p><em>Why it matters:</em> Docs are often the first impression contributors get. Schema-driven clarity starts here.</p>

<h2 id="getting-help">Getting Help</h2>
<ul>
  <li><a href="https://github.com/meshery/schemas/issues">GitHub Issues</a> - Report bugs or request features</li>
  <li><a href="https://slack.meshery.io">Community Slack</a> - Real-time discussions with maintainers</li>
  <li><a href="https://meshery.io/calendar">Weekly Meetings</a> - Join our community calls</li>
</ul>

<hr />
<blockquote>
  <p><strong>Community Resources</strong>
For more contribution guidelines, see the <a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md">Meshery Contributing Guide</a>.</p>
</blockquote>
